description: This file defines the 'Link' class which manages relationships between beans in a CRM system, handling various relationship types such as one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many. It includes methods for adding, deleting, querying, and managing relationships, along with handling relationship metadata and SQL query construction.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: A class for managing and manipulating relationships between objects/beans in the CRM. Supports different relationship types and provides methods for adding, deleting, querying, and managing linked records.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the Link object with relationship name, bean reference, field definitions, and optional table/key names.

methods.name: loadedSuccesfully
methods.description: Checks if the relationship object (record) was successfully loaded.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves related record IDs or data based on relationship type.

methods.name: getRelatedTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related table based on relationship position.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleName
methods.description: Returns the module name of the related object.

methods.name: getRelatedFields
methods.description: Returns the list of related fields.

methods.name: getRelatedField
methods.description: Returns a specific related field by name.

methods.name: getRelationshipObject
methods.description: Returns the relationship object (metadata).

methods.name: _get_bean_position
methods.description: Determines if the bean is on the left side of the relationship.

methods.name: _is_self_relationship
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is self-referential.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Constructs and returns the SQL JOIN clause(s) for the relationship.

methods.name: _add_deleted_clause
methods.description: Generates SQL fragment for filtering by deleted status.

methods.name: _add_optional_where_clause
methods.description: Appends optional filtering conditions to queries.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Builds and returns the SQL query string for fetching related records.

methods.name: getBeans
methods.description: Returns bean objects related to the current bean, based on the relationship.

methods.name: _add_one_to_many_table_based
methods.description: Adds a link record in a one-to-many relationship table.

methods.name: _add_many_to_one_bean_based
methods.description: Associates a bean with a parent in a many-to-one relationship.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a relationship link between the current bean and another record(s).

methods.name: _add_many_to_many
methods.description: Inserts or updates a record in a many-to-many relationship join table, checking for duplicates.

methods.name: _delete_row
methods.description: Marks a relationship record as deleted in the join table.

methods.name: _update_row
methods.description: Updates a relationship record in the join table.

methods.name: _insert_row
methods.description: Inserts a new relationship record into the join table.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a relationship between records, updating statuses or deleting links.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Checks if a relationship link already exists in the join table to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: _get_alternate_key_fields
methods.description: Retrieves alternative key fields for a join table for duplicate checking.

methods.name: _get_link_table_definition
methods.description: Fetches metadata definition for a join/link table.

methods.name: _get_link_table_role_field
methods.description: Returns the role field name for a many-to-many join table.
